Beyond Meat · EVERFI

Keeping progress visible across environmental learning.

Beyond Meat and EVERFI’s Sustainability Foundations introduces resources, biodiversity, climate and innovation through a connected course experience.

ProjectSustainability Foundations
Contribution / source recordProject-specific role to confirm.

Design approach

  • Hub cards distinguish starting a lesson from reviewing completed content.
  • Lesson progress, assessment status and retake states are presented as separate actions.
  • Introductory and post-assessment flows account for different points in the learner journey.

Why this work matters

The design opportunity is making a multi-topic course easy to resume and navigate without obscuring assessment status.
